preset.title: MASooda showcase: one campus afternoon, every feature
preset.description: One 6-minute IITH afternoon at 38 °C with a 4 m/s westerly. 150 drones fly the campus corridors on 7 layers while the DTC and V2V layer agreement share the airspace and ADMM resolves conflicts. On top of that, in order: a non-cooperative intruder, two blood deliveries to the Hospital on the reserved emergency layer, GPS spoofing filtered by W-MSR and quarantined, operator console actions on a courier, a pop-up VIP restricted area, three battery/health faults handled by the BMS and DTC (pad arbitration, diversion, fleet grounding), a DTC link outage with a hold lost-link policy and a queued command, and a storm cell crossing the campus with a ground stop and a low-charge recall.
timeline: 150 drones, 7 layers, 38 °C, 4 m/s westerly; fleet lost-link policy = hold
@intruder (no Remote ID) Sampoorna → New Hostels: seen only by onboard sensing
@blood1 EMERGENCY SNCC → Hospital, priority 0, reserved emergency layer
@blood2 EMERGENCY Main Gate → Hospital: same pad, pad arbitration
Operator speed limit 6 m/s in sector S4 (intruder)
@spoof1, @spoof2 broadcast positions 30 m off: trusted-range + W-MSR correct them
Console on @courier: change layer, hold, resume, reroute to Mess B
@hot1 overheating fault: pack heats, WARNING → CRITICAL → diversion
VIP restricted area announced; active 120–200 s over Academic Area / LHC
@cargo2 (31 %) loses 30 % capacity, BMS learns it from voltage → low-reserve diversion
@cargo1 cell failure → BMS CRITICAL, right of way, pad reserved, diverts
Operator grounds every BMS CRITICAL drone
DTC link down (to 265 s): drones loiter; command at 245 s queued
Link back: queued command delivered, held drones released
Storm cell drifts Main Gate → SNCC; ground stop in S3 at 285 s
kpi_focus: BMS escalations, diversions, no energy depletion
